components.label: Custom agents: poller (haiku-pinned watcher), scripted-runner (sonnet-pinned executor)
Hook scripts: malware guards (git push / npm install / git pull) + PR babysitter
components.notes: Wired up by hooks in settings.json. On Windows these need Git Bash; verify `bash` resolves in the hook environment.

components.label: Custom statusline (statusline-custom.sh + claude-code-statusline package v2.24.0)
components.notes: settings.json statusLine points at ~/.claude/statusline-custom.sh. Bash-based — Git Bash/WSL on Windows.

components.label: Plugins (8): superpowers, context7, slack, swift-lsp, coderabbit, claude-md-management, imessage, caveman
install: then inside Claude Code: /plugin install caveman@caveman
components.notes: enabledPlugins + extraKnownMarketplaces are already in settings.json; installs must still run. imessage + swift-lsp are macOS-relevant only — skip on Linux/Windows. slack/coderabbit/context7 auth on first use.

components.label: User-scope MCP servers: brain-fs, excalidraw, monday, CompAI, gmessages
components.notes: Each has prereqs and/or secrets — see mcp/mcp-servers.json _prereq fields and INSTALL_AGENT.md. CompAI needs an API key from the user. brain-fs/gmessages depend on local systems not in this repo.

components.label: External CLI tools: agent-browser, carbontype, mcp_excalidraw build
components.notes: agent-browser v0.27.0 (brew/npm), carbontype (github.com/HAR5HA-7663/carbontype), mcp_excalidraw (github.com/yctimlin/mcp_excalidraw). See external-deps.md.

components.label: Personal brain (~/brain) — NOT in this repo
components.notes: Private data; user must copy ~/brain from the old machine themselves (AirDrop/rsync/drive). Until then: SessionStart hook, brain-fs MCP, and brain/wiki skills will no-op or error — installer should skip or comment those out if brain is absent.
